title: IIIT Community Forum
description: Designed and implemented REST APIs using Fastify and PostgreSQL to handle posts, comments, and scalable threaded discussions. Enforced secure platform access through institute-verified email authentication and a robust relational schema, serving 100+ active users.

title: Chowkidaar Discord Bot
description: Migrated legacy commands to Discord Slash Commands, improving user experience and reducing latency by 40%. Engineered high-availability GCP backend with systemd maintaining 99%+ uptime for 200+ members, and optimized database pooling with Neon.

title: EEE Bootcamp Platform
description: Full-stack platform restricted to institute emails using OAuth2 and automatic academic batch assignment logic. Developed backend services via Supabase to manage and store 40+ authenticated student profiles.

title: D3 Fest Website
description: Central hub for fest events, schedules, and registrations with a scalable component system, built for Tech Society, IIIT Bhubaneswar.

title: Advaita Fest Website
description: Full event platform for Advaita, the annual cultural and technical fest of IIIT Bhubaneswar, focusing on scalability and reusable UI components.
